liveRead.note: Latest movement includes Codex-labeled synthetic counter tests. Treat as pipeline proof, not organic traffic proof.

diagnosis: The analytics pipe is working, but the public audience lane is dry. Isolated feature phrases such as GLB viewer, podcast clip, or 3D analytics are too narrow. DigitalHut needs a full-session phrase that matches why a normal video viewer would choose the dapp.
primaryCrowdPhrase: YouTube alternative full-view episode with 3D model view, podcast moments, and live analytics

crowdBands.searcherState: Wants a different way to watch a topic after YouTube/TikTok fatigue.
crowdBands.digitalhutPromise: Same video rhythm plus 3D model view, podcast moment, and readable analytics.

crowdBands.searcherState: Wants an explained video, not just a video.
crowdBands.digitalhutPromise: The episode explains the topic with source links, timeline, GLB context, and podcast interruption.

crowdBands.searcherState: Wants an all-in-one media interface for any topic.
crowdBands.digitalhutPromise: Video, sound, next episode, 3D, podcast, and analytics in one dapp interface.
